name: [🧪Mutations] Steal A Haikyu Character
desc:
Welcome to Steal A Haikyuu Character!
Make sure to Like and Follow the game for future content! (There will be more)

How to Play:
💸When you get in use your starting cash to buy a Haikyuu Character
🥷 Steal A Haikyuu Character from the other players around the map to boost progress
💸 Generate money using your Haikyuu Character
🐦‍🔥 Use that money to upgrade lockers and rebirth
✋ Defend your hard earned Characters with tools

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
